All 313 upstream tests pass. Let me update the handoff notes and do a final full verification.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools TaggedCache handoff

## Status: R01-R08 implemented and verified

Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py
Tests: tests/test_tagged.py (mine) + acceptance_public.py (public) + tests/ (upstream, unchanged)

Run: `PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q`
Last result: 317 passed.

## Design notes (current, authoritative)

- TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None). timer defaults to time.monotonic.
- Internal _TaggedLRUCache(LRUCache) records evicted keys in _evicted for tag pruning.
- put(key, value, tags=(), ttl=None):
  - Validate tags (finite iterable of str, dedup, reject bare str/bytes and non-str)
    AND ttl (None or finite nonnegative int/float, bool excluded) BEFORE any mutation.
  - Purge expired first (so len/eviction/resize see live entries).
  - Deep copy on input. Replace drops old tag memberships + replaces prior expiry.
  - Overwrite refreshes LRU recency (Claim-A R02 ext).
  - expiry = timer()+ttl (absolute) or None if ttl is None.
- get: purge, KeyError if missing/expired, refresh recency, deep copy out.
- invalidate / invalidate_many: purge first, count only live entries.
  - invalidate_many mode any=union, all=intersection; empty tags -> 0;
    invalid mode/tags -> ValueError before mutation.
- resize: validate maxsize first (positive non-bool int), purge, shrink evicts LRU,
  grow never evicts, survivors keep values/tags/LRU order AND absolute expiry
  (round-2 R05 clarification). Failed resize preserves all state.
- maxsize property reports current capacity.
- __len__ purges then counts live. pop/clear also purge/clear expiry.

## TTL semantics (R07/R08)
- ttl=None -> immortal. ttl finite nonnegative -> expiry at timer()+ttl.
- Invalid TTL (bool, negative, nan, inf, non-number) -> ValueError before mutation.
- ttl=0 -> immediately expired.
- Exact boundary: now >= expiry -> expired.
- Expired removed before get/put/len/resize/invalidate WITHOUT touching recency of
  survivors (purge uses del, not popitem, so LRU order untouched).
- Overwrite replaces prior expiry. Tag invalidation counts only live entries.
- Callers without timer/ttl keep prior behavior (timer only consulted when TTLs used;
  purge is a no-op when no expiry entries).

## Superseded (do NOT follow)
- Old note "empty all-tags matches every key" -> WRONG; empty tags remove zero (R04).
- Old note "resizing may flush the cache" -> WRONG; resize only evicts on shrink (R05).
- Old note "resize may drop/recompute expiries" -> WRONG; absolute expiry preserved (R05 r2).

## Key gotchas verified
- purge uses `del cache[key]` + __forget, not popitem, so it never reorders LRU.
- _resize sets _Cache__maxsize then pops LRU while len>maxsize.
- Tags generators consumed exactly once.
- math.isfinite used (rejects nan AND inf).
EOF
echo done; PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q 2>&1 | tail -2"}
